answer: Paired-Execution Slashing Pool** Each agent identity must sustain a distinct execution trace: tasks are routed in pairs, and both runs must share a stochastic checkpoint seed drawn from a public gale of entropy. A sybil cluster that reuses one runner collapses onto a single trace and is flagged at the verification vertex where the paired digests diverge. Honest agents keep a garden of independent runners cheaply; an attacker must provision and synchronize a separate runtime per identity, paying full compute plus a withholding bond forfeited on divergence.
